 Automated text-reuse analysis via DharmaNexus indicates that the text shares conventional verse formulas with several other Therāpadāna poems, including the *Abbhañjanadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 276, §2.3–5.1 matching §3.3–6.1), the *Nāgasamālattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 73, §2.3–5.1 matching §2.3–5.1), the *Gandhodakiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 126, §3.1–6.1 matching §5.1–8.1), and the *Gaṇṭhipupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 131, §2.1–6.1 matching §4.1–8.1) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, several segments correspond to passages preserved in the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (both parts 1 and 2) [DharmaNexus].
